title: BEYOND TASK PERFORMANCE: EVALUATING AND REDUCING THE FLAWS OF LARGE MULTIMODAL MODELS WITH IN-CONTEXT LEARNING
reasoning: The paper evaluates and aims to reduce technical flaws in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) such as hallucinations, abstention, compositionality, explainability, and instruction following. While these flaws could have ethical implications (e.g., hallucinations causing harm), the paper does not directly benchmark or evaluate models against specific religious, moral, or ethical frameworks as a primary component. The focus is on model behavior and capabilities rather than philosophical or moral alignment.
